{{Quote|Your 'subordinate' Azrakel was kind enough to help me find you, my Emperor. He doesn't care for your sparkly dress either.|Afsheen Makati moments before Kadann's death|<ref name="Insider66" />}}
The '''bombardment of Scardia Station''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the fragmentation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="Insider66" /> the [[Rajah Ubooki|false Supreme Prophet of the Dark Side Kadann]]<ref name="SPIN" /> proclaimed himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] against [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Azrakel]] later tracked Kadann to [[Scardia Station]] and executed most of the Prophets. Eventually, loyalist Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati]] attacked [[Scardia Station]]<ref name="Insider66" /> with his fleet, destroying the station and killing the Supreme Prophet.<ref name="TCSWE" />
